verdict.rationale: Superset ships an official TypeScript SDK for creating/managing workspaces, tasks, projects, and automations from code, backed by a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec and a documented/CLI-verified MCP server, giving AI-native users multiple sanctioned programmatic entry points. Missing for 10: SDKs in languages beyond TypeScript and independent (non-vendor) confirmation that developers actually build against the SDK in production.
